CJP chief spokesperson Saurav Das was stopped from travelling to the United Kingdom after authorities flagged an alleged discrepancy in his passport's place of birth. Das shared a video from Delhi airport, claiming he was prevented from attending events at Oxford, Cambridge, the London School of Economics and the University of Edinburgh, where he was scheduled to speak about the Cockroach Movement.
